name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer holding a strategic land position and royalty interests across multiple projects in Nevada and Idaho, focused on historically high-grade mining districts within the Walker Lane gold trend. The company's portfolio includes the Lazy Claims, Loman, Agai-Pah, and Swales properties in Mineral and Elko Counties, Nevada, as well as earn-in and royalty agreements on third-party-operated projects. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage, primarily growing its asset base through royalty acquisitions and exploration partnerships.
